object: R0D0.q1 (a1,d1): 3-round BLAKE3 generic-birthday circuit, round 0 diagonal call D0, quarter-step 1
question: Q3 degrees of freedom: which message words reach this step, how many free bits, and whether any constant choice changes the count.
number: Reaches this step: message words [0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8]; one of them is free (m8 = 32 free bits); the other words are fixed zeros. The step is a bijection in m8: 1048576 distinct m8 values gave 1048576 distinct outputs (structural: add, xor and rotate by constants are bijections). Ops invariant over 300 random prefixes: [7]. Zero-immediate constructions for this step's immediates (K = v0+v5 (add) and v15 (xor)): closed-form solves of m1/m3/m5/m7 make them vanish (each alone: 597/596/596/596 ops for v0/v5/v10/v15 = 0; all four: 599, circuit verified correct) - every variant is worse than 595 because a nonzero prefix word costs +2 in rounds 1-2 while deleting one immediate saves 1. Prefix is fixed by the target anyway.
notes: Universe cell blake3-r3|R0D0.q1|step|Q3. Dependency sets from taint propagation; injectivity checked on a 2^20 sample; zero-immediate prefixes solved in closed form (scan3.py) and re-counted.
